passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My best friend is Tom, and I trust him.
phrases.ko: 나의 가장 친한 친구는 톰이고, 나는 톰을 믿어요.

phrases.en: He always helps me, and I help him too.
phrases.ko: 톰은 항상 나를 도와주고, 나도 톰을 도와요.

phrases.en: We laugh every day, and we play every day.
A true friend is the best kind of friend.
I am happy when I am with Tom.
phrases.ko: 나는 톰과 함께 있을 때 행복해요.

phrases.en: We trust each other because we are honest.
He always waits for me after school.
phrases.ko: 톰은 방과 후에 항상 나를 기다려요.

phrases.en: We play soccer, and then we laugh.
A best friend knows when you are sad.
phrases.ko: 가장 친한 친구는 내가 슬플 때를 알아요.

phrases.en: I help him, and he helps me.
phrases.ko: 나는 톰을 돕고, 톰은 나를 도와요.

phrases.en: Every day with my best friend is a good day.
phrases.ko: 가장 친한 친구와 보내는 매일은 좋은 날이에요.

full_passage_spoken: My best friend is Tom, and I trust him. He always helps me, and I help him too. We laugh every day, and we play every day. A true friend is the best kind of friend. I am happy when I am with Tom. We trust each other because we are honest. He always waits for me after school. We play soccer, and then we laugh. A best friend knows when you are sad. I help him, and he helps me. Every day with my best friend is a good day.
